skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 70% ATK damage to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Gains an Undying state (survives lethal damage up to 3 times). Marks the target's entire column, then deals 260% ATK damage to that column (scaled by the number of marks). Afterward, Dispels all debuffs from self.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Gains an Undying state (survives lethal damage up to 3 times) and +40% Crit DMG to self. Marks the target's entire column, then deals 260% > 300% ATK damage to that column (scaled by the number of marks). Afterward, Dispels all debuffs from self.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP%. At the end of his turn, tallies all healing done by all allies and heals self for a share of that total.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP%. At the end of his turn, tallies all healing done by all allies and heals self for a share of that total.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP%. At the end of his turn, tallies all healing done by all allies and heals self for a share of that total.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At the start of battle, summons 1 Dark Pirate Member with HP equal to 1800% of Boros' ATK. The summoned unit shares 80% of the DMG taken by allies in the same row (all DMG types except Emblem Skill ATK or Reflect DMG). After its HP is depleted, deals extra DMG equal to 30% of the summoned unit's Max HP to 3 random enemies.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Dark Pirate Members summoned 1 > 2. DMG-sharing target: same-row allies > all allies.
